title: Netherfortress
description: Notifies first-time Nether visitors of the nearest fortress coordinates
body:
# Netherfortress - Nether Fortress Locator

A lightweight plugin that automatically notifies players of the nearest Nether Fortress coordinates when they enter the Nether for the first time.

## Features

- **Auto Detection** - Automatically detects when a player enters the Nether
- **First-Time Only** - Only notifies on the player's first Nether visit
- **Persistent Tracking** - Uses PersistentDataContainer to remember across server restarts
- **Fortress Locator** - Finds the nearest fortress within 1000 blocks
- **Clear Messages** - Displays X and Z coordinates with helpful Y-level hint
- **Zero Configuration** - Works out of the box, no setup required

## How It Works

1. Player enters the Nether
2. Plugin checks if this is their first visit (using PDC)
3. If first visit, searches for nearest Nether Fortress
4. Sends coordinates to the player
5. Flags player so they won't receive message again

## Message Example
```
§6ネザー到達おめでとう！
§b最寄りのネザー要塞の座標: §fX: 150, Z: -300§bはここです。
§7(要塞はY座標32〜80付近に生成されます)
```

## Commands

No commands - fully automatic plugin.

## Permissions

No permissions required - works for all players automatically.

## Requirements
- Spigot/Paper 1.21.x
- Java 17+

---

## 日本語 (Japanese)

初めてネザーに入ったプレイヤーに、最寄りのネザー要塞の座標を自動通知するプラグインです。

**機能:**
- ネザー初入場を自動検出
- 半径1000ブロック内の最寄り要塞を検索
- X/Z座標とY座標のヒントを表示
- PersistentDataContainerで初回入場を永続追跡
- 設定不要、コマンド不要の完全自動動作
